newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Oct 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Oct 29.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President Henri Konan Bedie tells his ruling Democratic Party at their 10th ordinary congress that times are changing, urges honesty and hard work and preaches participative democracy involving opposition as well as all levels of Ivorian society
- Four-day ruling party congress disrupts public services as staff attend the meeting rather than go to work and buses are requisitioned to ferry delegates and their guests around --
- For the first time, Bedie talks of opening his government to the (main) opposition.

- An announcement from the Abidjan port authority reminds port users of Closing Date rules that have been governing the export of containers since August 1; the arrival of all such containers must be logged with details published ahead of the arrival of the ship taking them
